Concrete dataset/assumptions context is required, beyond a broad statistics rating.
Keep numerical, accurate and organized study-record evidence.
Explaining study results is a separate requirement; do not infer research leadership.
A chosen team/workflow investigation supplies the organizational context. Existing numerical/investigation requirements remain.
A distinct project-review/coordination context is needed before inferring interest in implementing organizational changes.
Stock/materials or a concrete delivery-comparison context is required.
Generic appointments or office records do not establish supplier/delivery coordination.
Testing an audience message supplies a concrete communication context; negotiating a purchase alone does not.

limitations: Research only; new authored follow-up items and semantic links are not independently validated scales or real student outcomes.
0.71 profiles, Yes/No/Unsure and held records are unchanged. Unknown facts remain unknown; positive simulation answers only reuse frozen facts. Source reuse is not independent confirmation.

Ten binding rules are distinct from connecting seven prior evidence-answer types and from newly offered targeted questions. All prior 0.71 responses, including unknowns, are reused rather than re-asked.

Scoped choices connect only to reviewed question/construct targets. Technical safety does not supply clinical, financial or legal responsibility. New curriculum-coordinator support needs actual educator-coaching context.

Current live results, previous research, binding-only results, wired prior responses and additional targeted responses are reported separately. No degree/pay ranking boost, no cap change and no new correlation threshold.
Development and three previously inspected holdouts use identical policies with separate results. They are diagnostic, not pristine final validation.

All 0.71 supported alternatives are retained. Top-three ordering can displace a degree, graduate or lifestyle option; such changes remain visible. All routes and existing pay proxies remain available; null pay is unassessed.
